title: English Practice Quiz 0960
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A pedestrian should cross the road at a ___.
questions.explanation: A designated crossing is intended to help pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: A red traffic light means drivers must ___.
questions.explanation: A red signal requires traffic to stop.

questions.question: Wearing a seat belt helps reduce the risk of ___.
questions.explanation: Seat belts help restrain occupants during a crash.

questions.question: A blind spot is an area around a vehicle that the driver ___.
options: can see clearly through the windscreen
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas not visible through the usual mirrors.

questions.question: When approaching a school zone, drivers should ___.
options: slow down and watch for children
questions.explanation: Children may cross unexpectedly, so extra care is needed.

questions.question: A helmet is important for a two-wheeler rider because it helps protect the ___.
questions.explanation: A properly fitted helmet helps protect the rider's head.

questions.question: At a roundabout, drivers should follow ___.
questions.explanation: Road users should follow signs, markings and applicable right-of-way rules.

questions.question: Using a mobile phone while driving can ___.
questions.explanation: Phone use takes attention away from driving.

questions.question: A safe following distance gives a driver more time to ___.
questions.explanation: A sufficient gap allows time to respond to sudden changes.

questions.question: If an emergency vehicle approaches with siren and lights, drivers should ___.
options: give way safely according to traffic rules
questions.explanation: Giving way safely helps emergency responders reach their destination.
